constraints: Cannot be used to read file-type data from the pasteboard; use Get file from pasteboard for that.

overloadMerges.note: Corrected direction: data is filled in by the command ('←' in the docs), not passed in.

params.name: dataType
params.description: A 4D signature, a UTI type (macOS), a format name/number (Windows), or a 4-character type (compatibility) identifying the pasteboard data to retrieve.

params.name: data
params.description: Requested data extracted from the pasteboard; if the pasteboard held text copied within 4D, the BLOB's character set is likely UTF-16.
